title: Household emergency plan builder
dek: Organize who to call, where to meet, who needs extra help and when to practice. Print the plan and wallet cards, or save a text copy. It runs in your browser and keeps nothing.
description: A free, private planner for your household's emergency plan: contacts, meeting places, schools, pets, access needs and practice dates, with print and wallet cards.
recheck: If Ready.gov, FEMA or the CDC revise their planning pages, or at the next quarterly source sweep.

source_use.start-ready-plan: The five planning questions and the list of household factors.
source_use.ready-are-you-ready: Out-of-area contact reachable two ways; wallet or digital copy; meeting places in different directions; school reunification; practice like a fire drill.
source_use.start-cdc-pyh-connected: Two meeting places; text messages; microchip pets; account for children, older adults and pets.
source_use.start-cdc-disability-plan: Contact list of the people who support health; check-ins; practice and annual review.
source_use.start-ready-evacuation: Choose a pet-friendly place in advance because most public shelters allow only service animals.
source_use.start-cdc-pyh-prescriptions: Talk to a doctor or pharmacist about an emergency supply of medicines; no number of days is given.
source_use.start-ready-power: Talk to your medical provider about a plan for powered medical devices and refrigerated medicine.
